text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On this day, I came to the studio with the other Umamusume of my generation for a magazine photoshoot.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Waah~! Everyone looks so cool in their racewear!
It's really overwhelming after all~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Kris S-chan looks totally locked in,
like she's completely battle-ready!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Gimlet-chan is brimming with originality, and she really stands out.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Fine-chan feels so graceful,
refined, and glamorous~!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Even when compared, my racing silks are—
choice_data_list: Your racing outfit holds its own just as well!
Your racing outfit is just as stunning!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: ......That is true.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: I haven't lost, you know!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah, no... of course, it's not like it's exceptionally amazing or anything.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Even so, however――

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I haven't lost.
I believe I didn't fall behind at all!
choice_data_list: You're brimming with confidence, aren't you.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe.
I was very particular about my racing outfit, after all.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: ......I'm sure you already know this, Trainer-san, but...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
The number of Umamusume who actually get to wear
racing silks is reaaally just a tiny handful, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Japan's pinnacle Twinkle Series,
and an outfit worn only in the GⅠ races
that only a tiny handful get to compete in.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, because of that...
Racewear is something to aspire to.
...For me as well."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: When they asked me what design I wanted for my outfit... I had a really hard time deciding.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Even if I make racewear, I might not make a mark in GⅠ races,
and it might all end up going to waste..."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"You hear stories like that all the time...
I wonder if the same thing will happen to me..."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
“I even thought about things like that.
But... then I remembered.”

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I have people cheering me on.
My family, and Trainer. So—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I just wanted to at least show you
how cool I can be to live up to your expectations!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I may just be an ordinary Umamusume, but still!
At least when I'm wearing my racing silks,
I want to be able to say, 'Even so!'"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Keeping that in mind, I pushed my design to the absolute limit in my own way!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
For the color scheme, we could go with blue tones
so it stands out on the track—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"With reflective decorations,
we can make sure it's spotted even from far away!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Because I poured all those feelings into it,
my Racewear, *at least*, isn't losing to anyone!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: ……Wait, hahaha~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'm totally not pulling off this look yet,
so I'm still just a totally "ordinary" Umamusume~!
choice_data_list: With that much passion poured into it, there's no way it's ordinary!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Umm... haha.
I'm really glad to hear that~!
choice_data_list: Let's build up the strength worthy of your racing outfit.
Let's put that enthusiasm to good use in training!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, if that happens, you'll be totally unstoppable! Truly the strongest~!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Mirako-san is the strongest when she's in her racing racewear! Hehe, good to know~♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—The strongest, huh?
—I would request a match.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Once you achieve greatness, shall we reenact the battle of the gods together...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh, no way, that's not it!
I said that was only if she had the skill for it!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'm still just a totally nor~mal Umamusume!
Becoming the strongest is still way, way, way, way out of reach~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Distant", huh... Her not saying that being the strongest was impossible
felt like proof of the trust she placed in her racing outfit.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: What do you think~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
You know how moody I can be, right?
I just hope my motivation holds out~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though Hishi Miracle said that with
a thoroughly listless expression—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Um... could you take one more picture?
I feel like I didn't quite nail the pose.

text_block_list.name: Cameraman A
text_block_list.text:
Got it!
Alright, one more photo coming up~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Yes! Let's do it~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her enthusiastically putting her all into the photoshoot
made her shine brighter than anyone else there.
